evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 1.7 ppm at growth onset, consistent with the low post-purge baseline.
Oxygen rose to 12.2 ppm during growth despite unchanged temperature and argon setpoints.
Oxygen has risen persistently to 25.3 ppm, indicating an atmosphere anomaly.
Thermocouple reads 749.5 C against a 750 C setpoint.
Measured argon flow is 100.3 sccm against a 100 sccm setpoint; no indicated flow failure.

args.missing_evidence: Independent oxygen verification and leak/exhaust-path checks are needed to distinguish air ingress, exhaust restriction, and oxygen-sensor error; tube pressure is unavailable because no gauge is installed. Sample characterization is not yet available.
